# WrestleFest sound command mapping

# GENERATED by tools/extract_z80_sound_map.py from the Z80 sound
# ROM's own dispatch tables (0x20DF / 0x2141 / 0x21A3). Do not
# hand-edit the rows: re-run the tool. Provenance and the
# disassembly trail are in that script's docstring.
#
# Format: <cmd_hex> <bank> <phrase> <wav_file> [label...]
#   bank 'cur' = play from whichever bank is currently selected;
#   the Z80 only switches banks for explicit 0/1 commands, and a
#   switch stops every playing voice first.
#
# Format: stop <cmd_hex> [label...]
#   Silence every voice and reset the bank (Z80 handler 0x0106).
#
# Format: music <cmd_hex> [label...]
#   Commands below 0x20 take the YM2151 path at 0x0335 and trigger
#   no sample by design.
#
# Percussion (bank0_001/002) also loops autonomously under
# --sound-percussion; see docs/sound-and-timing.md.
